reason: A shared benchmark freezes learned stores and crosses learning-time versus evaluation-time noise to measure persistent robustness.
Atomic changes revise one instruction artifact, while tree lookahead and outcome memory change candidate selection and retention.
The numerical updater or memory manager participates in proposing its own independently admitted successor, then resumes the same role.
Contrasting diagnosed execution attempts produces reusable strategies and skills; the principal innovation is grounded reflection rather than raw-case retrieval.
A shared graph retains failed and successful research states and directs subsequent mutation, repair, and cross-lineage reuse.
Counterfactual failure attribution arbitrates between harness edits and targeted executor training, with lever-wise ablations.
Own successful and failed interaction trajectories are distilled into stratified reusable guidance and refined by environmental feedback.
Self-generated questions expose capability gaps; executable operators pass differential and metamorphic admission checks before cumulative reuse.
Controlled bank-content perturbations with fixed retrieval and longitudinal policy checkpoints isolate co-evolution-induced drift fragility.
Comparative raw execution evidence diagnoses skill-file defects and coordinates repairs, with non-elitist development separate from deployment.
Paired fixed-capacity rule exchanges estimate per-rule utility, and those values directly govern retention and replacement.
Adversarially repaired rubrics supply RL rewards, and persistent generation guidance is revised from discovered exploits.
The editable object is executable storage/retrieval logic, evaluated after comparable experience accumulation against the original learning mechanism.
A coding supervisor reads logs and edits harness source, but also searches model identity and prompts rather than strictly local code repairs.
Distributed feedback drives bounded revisions to one shared skill document; contribution emphasizes commit representation, privacy filtering, and aggregation.
Empirical prompt-evolution audit reports confounds and inconsistent gains, but strategy effects are associative rather than isolated causal interventions.
